displayIdentity.body: The LORD tells Moses to descend, names a stiff-necked people and threatened destruction, while Moses appeals to Egypt, reputation among nations, and promises to the ancestors; the LORD relents.
displayIdentity.title: The LORD announces corruption and Moses intercedes
